titles.title: The Frightened Horses and the Inquisitive Fish

description: Reproduction of signed illustration. In this Art Nouveau-inspired black and white illustration, three identical women run across a landscape of rolling hills. A river with jumping fish flows through the landscape. Horses run away from the women.
